evidence: Every time-varying, interactive or viewport promise in the brief is graded by a criterion that tells the judge to act, wait or resize, not to score a first paint. Live updates (conversations.md:33): scored/functional/judge.toml:241-243 keeps Gwen's page open in a separate context, scrolls, opens a reply box, types a draft, then requires the four changes 'without reloading, within about ten seconds' while draft, open box and scroll position survive. Live wall (walls-and-retention.md:63): functional:92-96 keeps Sian's page open and requires M-12 to vanish 'without reloading, within about ten seconds'. Per-tab unread (conversations.md:25): functional:212-216 uses two Dev contexts and waits ~10 s each time. @ suggestions: functional:81 types '@' and picks a suggestion. Stale edit: functional:171-173 holds an edit box open in a second context. Keyboard/confirm: polish:26 (Shift+Enter/Enter), :35 (Escape for edit and reply plus reload), :44 (decline, then confirm). Persistence over time: polish:53 (highlight still there ~10 s later) and :71 (refusal still shown after ~10 s untouched). Viewport (conversations.md:35): polish:62 resizes to 390x844 and measures documentElement.scrollWidth; visual prompt.md:49 says to resize to 1440x900 first and to 390x844 for phone_chambers (visual:75). No theme toggle or animation is promised, so nothing else needs exercising. Runtime corroboration (v2 bytes only): the hosted v2 Oracle judge measured thread scrollTop 695/1739 before the live updates, polled both Dev contexts (2->3 within ~2.1 s), and resized to 390 and 1440 (scrollWidth 390). The luna judge polled every 500 ms for 12 s. The golden polls every 2 s (app.js:642-650), well inside the 10 s window, and the scripted golden passes all live and polish legs (golden-run.log lines 5, 13, 15, 19-24). Risk is true only because no configured judge run exists on these v3 bytes. v3 replaced three polish rows, so the link_highlight ~10 s wait and the v3 wall_added_live wording have no judge observation; the scripted golden is not a judge run. Broken app tried: a page that re-fetches only on window focus or visibility change, with no background polling. It is caught by the unread criterion's untouched second context and by Sian's passive page in wall_added_live. It could slip through live_updates_keep_my_work only if switching tabs fires focus (P3, latent). Conforming alternative tried: a 9 s poller. It is protected by the explicit 'within about ten seconds' wording, and the prior judges did wait or poll. Minor P3 notes, not failures: (a) a timer-driven disappearance is never observed live in another tab; deletion stands in for 'a message disappears'. (b) The main thread's 390 px no-sideways-scroll is graded only by the likert phone_chambers (which resizes and was measured as scrollWidth by the v2 judge), while only the transcript gets a binary scrollWidth check.
